Varta 86: A Patel Vaishnav (Knowledge of Shri Yamunaji's Eight Siddhis), Disciple of Shri Gusainji

Listening to Shri Gusainji expound *Shri Yamunashtak*, a Patel Vaishnav from Gujarat asked which spiritual perfection (siddhi) corresponds to each of the eight verses. Shri Gusainji explained all eight in order: (1) a divine body fit for seva, (2) vision of divine leela, (3) experience of its rasa, (4) all-pervading divine vision (sarvatmabhav), (5) bestowal of bhakti, (6) knowing the Lord's inner intent, (7) captivating the Lord, and (8) nourishing Bhagavad-rasa. Instantly, Shri Yamunaji granted the Patel direct vision of all eight!

End of Varta 86.
